items.q: What is a browser emulator online?
items.a: It lets you open a different browser from your own browser to test a website. TestMu AI uses real browsers on real machines rather than imitations.
Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Opera and Internet Explorer across Windows and macOS versions.

items.q: Can I test Safari on Windows?
items.a: Yes. You open real Safari running on a Mac from your Windows browser.
The free plan gives 1 parallel test with limited live sessions renewed every month.

items.q: How is this different from virtual browsers?
items.a: Virtual browsers are for browsing in isolation. This page is for testing websites across browsers and versions.
